Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help shape and build the next generation of our network automation platforms.

Our challenge is one of scale, complexity and criticality. We operate a massive global network supporting PlayStation Network, spanning more than 40 interconnection locations and 20+ data centres worldwide. Operating infrastructure at this scale safely and efficiently requires us to move beyond specialist-driven workflows and individual automation tools toward reliable, declarative software platforms.

You will help make that transition. You will work on software that turns complex network and infrastructure operations into reliable, API-driven and increasingly self-service capabilities. This includes building control-plane services, declarative APIs and intent-based controllers that manage production infrastructure safely and consistently across our global footprint.

This is a Staff-level engineering role with significant technical influence. You will combine hands-on engineering with setting technical direction: defining architectures, solving complex cross-system and distributed-systems problems, writing designs, driving alignment with senior engineers and architects, and mentoring engineers across the team.

Your work will directly influence how one of the world's largest gaming networks is operated and automated, while establishing engineering patterns and platforms that can be reused across multiple network domains and services.

What you'll be doing:

  • Provide technical leadership and architectural direction for network automation and infrastructure control platforms, treating the self-service network API as a product by working with users and partner teams to define outcomes, establish clear expectations for API behavior and reliability, align on team responsibilities, and ensure those commitments are met.
  • Use domain-driven design with network experts, software engineers and API consumers to establish shared language and bounded contexts, then turn those agreements into versioned, testable contracts.
  • Design and build APIs, services, controllers and reconciliation workflows that manage production infrastructure safely at scale.
  • Build on the Kubernetes API, including custom resources and control loops that continuously converge actual state toward declared intent.
  • Own the operational Kubernetes path: CRD rollout, RBAC and admission, controller health, Helm packaging, deployment drift and incident diagnosis.
  • Design distributed workflows that operate correctly under eventual consistency, at-least-once delivery, concurrent writes and partial failure, with idempotency and safe recovery as fundamental properties.
  • Design stable APIs, schemas and data models used across team boundaries, including versioning and backwards compatibility.
  • Develop patterns for multi-tenant infrastructure platforms, including tenant isolation, authorization, policy enforcement and safe automation boundaries.
  • Establish strong approaches to testing, observability and change safety for software that changes live infrastructure.
  • Improve software delivery practices through automated CI gates, versioned artifacts, controlled promotion, and safe deployment and recovery strategies.
  • Lead complex migrations and modernization of existing automation, services and data models, evaluating when components should be evolved, replaced or rewritten, and ensuring safe coexistence, behavioral compatibility and retirement of legacy paths.
  • Drive technical alignment across software engineering, networking, operations and architecture teams; lead decisions within your area of accountability, contribute constructively to decisions owned by others, and make technology choices based on long-term company and product value.
  • Mentor engineers, lead technical and design reviews, and raise software engineering standards across the wider organization.

What we're looking for:

Must have

  • Deep expertise in a backend language such as Python, Go, Rust or Java, including asynchronous concurrency, static typing, data modelling and validation, API development, packaging and tooling.

title: Technical Product Owner
description: 🏢 Who we are A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone We are a software company developing a zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company. Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open-source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone. Want to see what we're working on? Check out our GitHub repo at https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird or https://netbird.io/knowledge-hub ✏️ What you will do As a Technical Product Owner at NetBird, you'll be the link between our users and our engineering team on the core NetBird platform. That means the clients, the dashboard and API, and the self-hosted setup. Today our CTO covers product next to running engineering, and you'll take over a big part of the day to day. You keep the backlog in Linear in good shape, turn feedback from customers and the community into clear, well-scoped work and make sure engineers can spend their time building. You'll report to our CTO and work closely with engineering, support and sales. You will: Own the day-to-day backlog in Linear. Triage incoming issues, write clear tickets with context and acceptance criteria and keep priorities current. Build a simple system for collecting feedback from customers, GitHub issues, community channels, support and sales calls, and turn it into well-framed problems the team can act on. Talk to users and customers directly to understand their setups and the problem behind each request. Plan our regular cycles with engineering, break bigger features into shippable pieces, and follow them through to release. Keep the rest of the company in the loop on what's shipping, from release notes and changelogs to updates for sales and support. Close the loop with the people who gave feedback, so they know what happened with it. Spot patterns across feedback and bring them into roadmap discussions, backed by data where you can. This is a technical product owner role. You won't write production code, but unlike a classic product owner you'll go deep with engineers on how things work, reproduce issues yourself and judge how much effort a request really takes. It's also a hands-on role in a small team. There's no big product org around you yet, so you'll help shape how product work runs at NetBird as we grow. 🔎 What we are looking for We're looking for someone who is at home in technical conversations, both with our engineers and with our users, who mostly work in IT and infrastructure teams. You also like structure and keep a busy backlog in order. Must-Haves 3+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in a similar role at a (technical) B2B SaaS, infrastructure, or developer tools company. A technical background. You're comfortable reading API docs, following a GitHub discussion, and digging into how something works together with engineers. Understanding of networking basics like IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, and VPNs. Hands-on experience running a backlog in Linear, Jira, or similar, and writing tickets engineers can pick up without a follow-up meeting. Experience working directly with customers or users and turning their feedback into prioritized work. Good judgment on priorities. You can say no, explain why, and keep people aligned. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. You default to writing things down. You work AI native. You use AI tools and coding agents every day, for example to sort feedback, dig into a problem or draft tickets, and you know where they help and where they don't. Comfortable in a small, fast-moving team where processes are still being built. Nice-to-Haves Experience with networking, security, or zero trust products. Experience with open source projects or developer communities. Experience building CLI products. Hands-on experience with self-hosting, Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud infrastructure. Some coding experience, enough to read a PR or reproduce a bug yourself. Experience using product analytics to back up decisions. 😌 What’s in it for you We want you to do meaningful work and be proud of what you build. That’s why we offer: Comprehensive compensation package : Receive a competitive base salary and equity incentives. Hybrid work environment : Enjoy the flexibility of working both from our centrally located Berlin office and remotely. Real product ownership: A direct say in what our engineering team builds next. Open source impact: Work in the open on a popular open source project, in direct contact with our customers and community. Growth opportunities : The chance to build up our product team from the start, with room to grow as NetBird scales. If you don't tick every box, apply anyway. And if you have time, try NetBird first and tell us in your application one thing you'd change. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. The team is small enough that engineers own problems end to end, from design through on-call. About you You're a staff-level engineer who wants to own systems, not tickets. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place. Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published. Your mission Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you. 1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against. 2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on. 3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not. 4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough. Your profile The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant : a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. A legal quant builds with it. They look at a workflow and ask how to redesign it from first principles to get the best possible outcome, rather than making the existing process incrementally faster. A note on how we are weighting this role. Three capabilities make someone exceptional here: commercial instinct, legal depth, and technical ability to build. The ideal candidate has all three. description: Are you a bit tired of the standard, old-fashioned way of doing things in the construction industry? Do you get deep satisfaction from making things run more efficiently using a good dose of common sense and maybe a bit of technology? People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. ( Read more about our vision and missions .) It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it. ( Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos. ) Core values for a good life A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has: - Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself - Care about people – your relationship with others around you - Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team - Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world We enshrined our values in our vision: We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that: - Connects us with meaningful relationships - Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans - Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions: - To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation - To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society ____________________________________________________________ The Role Purpose of the role You’ll be enhancing the delivery of the most complex and interesting projects in the world through the power of project planning to the very highest standards. You’ll devise strategies and tactics to improve the way the project is delivered. You’ll translate this knowledge into a logic-linked plan and analyse it using planning software. Then you’ll use the plan to help the teams understand what to prioritise. Your team This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy team which focuses on: - Understanding what the real problems of projects are - Implementing the best solutions to those problems - Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology More specifically, you’ll be part of our Project Planning Team, who are industry leaders in the planning of complex construction projects. Your initial leader will be one of our planning discipline directors. Your top three objectives 1. To make construction projects deliver to near perfection 2. To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems 3. To develop yourself and everyone around you Your top five responsibilities 1. Own the plan: Own the project plan for one or more projects and ensure that the project is working to it effectively. Ensure delays are mitigated and managed commercially 2. Own the outcome: You're responsible for putting in your best effort to ensure the project team’s understanding and focus on the plan – no matter how stubborn they are 3. Report and inform: Provide simple, actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that help them deliver their part of the project more efficiently and effectively 4. Make scalable solutions : Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools in collaboration with the team so that long-term impact is achieved 5. Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionally and educate our clients to improve as well You must have: - A construction engineering background: You have at least 2+ years of experience on construction projects, experience in project planning both software and principles, as well as decent Excel skills, and a strong interest in data - Communication skills: You’re proficient in written and verbal English and have the charisma and influence to get construction people to do new things and take the best approach - Leadership capabilities: You lead yourself proactively and lead others by asking the right questions and challenging them - Impact: You have a track record of making projects and organisations better beyond just doing the basics – implementing scalable, repeatable solutions that had a significant positive impact Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: - You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge - You like to be the smartest person in the room - You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback - You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team ____________________________________________________________ Frequently Asked Questions What kinds of projects would I be working on? It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres , infrastructure (including defense, rail, and highways), high tech (such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects . These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. ( Check out our case stories .) Who are our clients? Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally. Where would I be working? One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life. How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry? You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry. The knowledge you capture will be used by us to build new products. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use. ____________________________________________________________ Benefits The standard stuff: - Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance - Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft The life-changing stuff: - In-house coaching. Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being - Equity upside. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future - and own a piece of it - Flexible working. Work where it makes sense - most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins - Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up ____________________________________________________________ Important! Applying properly We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining: - Why you want to join us - What you’ll bring to the team We aren't a giant, faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team, so your letter will be read carefully. After that, we’ll reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you get to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. A couple of technical and personal assessments follow to understand your capability based on our own development matrix. This is to ensure that when you join, you’re starting at the right level of responsibility. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

About the role: What's in the Box

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to join our global Consumer Experience team, working in either Growth or Consumer. This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role in an AI-native design environment. You'll own a problem space, influence what we build and why, and raise the standard of the designers around you.

Your focus area is confirmed during the process:

  • Growth: acquisition, conversion, checkout, payment, reactivation, and new purchase models.
  • Consumer: onboarding, subscription management, loyalty and rewards, referrals, discovery, cooking, and engagement.

At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.

What you’ll do: The Recipe

  • Own critical customer journeys end to end, from problem framing to a shipped, measured outcome.
  • Turn complex customer and business problems into simple experiences that communicate value clearly, reduce friction and build trust.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing, CRM, and other UX practitioners to shape product direction, balancing near-term impact with long-term customer trust and value.
  • Build reusable patterns that hold across meal kits and ready-to-heat.
  • Use AI throughout your practice, from synthesis and discovery to rapid prototyping and design-to-code, with tools such as Claude, Claude Code, Gemini, and Figma Make, and explore AI-native customer experiences.
  • Build alignment through evidence and clear rationale and raise the bar on your squad through critique and shared practice.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients

  • Typically 4–6+ years of product design experience, though we care more about the scope, complexity, and impact of your work than years alone.
  • End-to-end ownership of complex experiences, ideally in e-commerce, subscription, marketplace, or loyalty, with outcomes: what moved, by how much, and what you did when a result came back wrong.
  • Exceptional interface craft: interaction and visual design, information architecture, motion, and micro-interactions. Your portfolio shows judgment (what you decided and why), not just polish.
  • Experimentation fluency: you turn data and customer insight into design bets without trading away trust and customer value.
  • AI in your daily workflow. You give it the context and intent it needs, and you audit what comes back. Curiosity and appetite for working in code and AI-native tools.
  • Ownership: when the copy is wrong you fix it, and nothing falls between job descriptions.

title: Independent Consultant - Sustainable Bio-Materials & Regulatory Compliance
description: RSB – Roundtable on Sustainable Biomaterials is a global, multi-stakeholder organisation dedicated to driving the truly sustainable development of the bioeconomy. Frequently recognised as an industry leader in supply chain sustainability, RSB applies its best-in-class sustainability framework across sectors including aviation, chemicals, materials, and shipping. Our small, dedicated team operates remotely from countries around the world, working collaboratively with a diverse base of member organisations, industry partners, and policymakers. For more information, please visit www.rsb.org . Purpose of This Call RSB now invites eligible firms and individuals (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services described below. This Call for Expressions of Interest is not yet linked to a specific project or immediate assignment . RSB is building a pre-approved External Consultant Roster: a qualified pool of selected specialists and organisations that will be called upon for project-based work for the next 2-3 years. We are primarily seeking to engage consultancy firms, agencies, and other established organisations, providers that can offer dedicated capacity, depth of expertise, and continuity across assignments. At the same time, we warmly welcome expressions of interest from independent consultants and other individual specialists whose qualifications and experience match the profiles sought. Throughout this document, “Consultant” refers to both firms and individuals unless stated otherwise. Consultants accepted onto the roster will complete a brief onboarding process to become familiar with RSB’s systems, ways of working, and sustainability framework, so that engagements can begin efficiently when a relevant need is identified. When a specific project or capacity gap emerges, RSB will contact roster members whose profile best matches the assignment, share a defined scope of work, and invite them to submit a proposal. Inclusion on the roster is an expression of readiness and fit and not a guarantee of immediate work or remuneration. The Services The Sustainable Bio-Materials & Regulatory Compliance Consultant will provide regulatory compliance and sustainability assessment expertise for bio-based materials, sustainable fuels, feedstocks and related value chains. Consultants in this profile support RSB Advisory Services with the expert practical interpretation of regulatory frameworks, such as EU RED, CORSIA and relevant voluntary certification requirements, including their GHG calculation methodologies. They support feedstock eligibility, low-ILUC considerations, sustainability-risk screening, voluntary scheme benchmarking and compliance gap identification. Role purpose: To provide RSB with flexible, project-based technical capacity for assessing whether bio-based materials, fuels, feedstocks and supply chains meet applicable regulatory and voluntary sustainability requirements. The role helps RSB and its clients translate complex rules into defensible assessments, calculations and compliance pathways, particularly where GHG data quality, feedstock eligibility, certification readiness or regulatory interpretation are central to the assignment. Full or partial coverage: Applicants are eligible whether they wish to cover the full scope or only a clearly defined subset of the technical areas and task requirements described below (partial coverage), based on their knowledge, skills and capabilities. Partial coverage applicants are encouraged to submit their candidacy as well. Confidentiality: Due to non-disclosure and confidentiality commitments within RSB Advisory Services, specific project-related work cannot be attached to or disclosed in this call. Key Responsibilities • Contribute to narrowing and confirming the scope, system boundaries and methodological approach for assessments under EU RED, CORSIA, RSB or other relevant regulatory and voluntary sustainability frameworks. • Review third-party-supplied GHG inventory data, apply consistency and plausibility checks, validate assumptions, clean data, identify missing or unreliable data, and propose defensible proxies or literature-based values where appropriate. • Support or perform GHG calculations and carbon-intensity assessments using relevant or pre-defined methodologies and tools, including the RSB GHG Calculator where applicable. • Prepare clear GHG, LCA or sustainability assessment reports using agreed templates, including methodology, assumptions, data-quality notes, result presentation and interpretation. • Provide support for the technical understanding of sustainable bio-material pathways and low-ILUC risk considerations under EU RED, CORSIA, RSB or equivalent requirements. • Support regulatory and voluntary-scheme gap analyses by participating in the documentation of benchmarking requirements, identifying, verifying or validating compliance risks, and reviewing third-party organisational documentation against criteria (met, not met or not applicable). • Review certification-readiness documentation under RSB guidance, including evidence related to feedstock origin, traceability, chain of custody, sustainability criteria and GHG claims. • Support the interpretation of policy or regulatory requirements for specific feedstocks, technologies, products or markets by providing supporting data and literature reviews, and translate findings into practical compliance options in line with the applicable standard requirements. • Support the development or refinement of methodologies, blueprints and decision tools for innovative sustainability assessments involving bio-based materials, fuels, chemicals or emerging feedstock pathways. Requirements Essential (all applicants, firms and individuals, must meet these criteria): • Strong written and spoken English proficiency. • Ability to maintain regular availability overlapping with CET working hours of a minimum of 4 hours per day. • Proven output/delivery track record in your area of expertise. • Full compliance with all applicable local laws and regulations, including tax and social security obligations, and legal authorisation to perform consultancy services in the country of residence or operation. • Strong collaboration and communication skills, the ability to operate autonomously, and a proactive approach to communicating progress, risks, and opportunities in a clear and constructive manner. • Self-sufficiency in a remote and fully digital working environment with reliable internet connectivity. Video calls and collaborative tools will be used for coordination. Specific to this profile: • Proven hands-on experience applying EU RED, CORSIA, RSB or equivalent GHG and sustainability methodologies in client, certification, policy or project-development contexts. • Working knowledge of at least one major voluntary sustainability certification scheme, preferably RSB, ISCC or another scheme relevant to biofuels, SAF, biomass or bio-based materials. • Demonstrated ability to assess feedstock eligibility, GHG data quality, certification readiness or regulatory compliance for specific products, pathways or supply chains. • Ability to work independently with limited onboarding, document assumptions transparently and flag uncertainty, data gaps and compliance risks. • Strong written English and effective reporting skills for technical and non-technical audiences. • Strong communication skills and comfort working with client-provided data under confidentiality constraints. • CET ±5 hours time-zone compatibility, unless otherwise agreed for a specific assignment. For firms / agencies: • Ability to assign appropriately qualified personnel to assignments and to ensure continuity of delivery, including cover for absences. • Confirmation that the named individuals proposed for RSB assignments meet the essential criteria above. Desirable (will strengthen your Expression of Interest): • Working knowledge of the RSB standard and certification system in particular, or of ISCC. • Hands-on experience using the RSB GHG Calculator. • Experience developing or refining methodologies, blueprints or decision tools for emerging feedstock pathways, bio-based materials, fuels or chemicals. Indicative Outputs (may include but are not limited to): Specific deliverables, estimated time input, and project duration will be clarified in the Terms of Reference (TOR) issued to shortlisted roster members when a project need is identified. • Scoping notes defining system boundaries and the methodological approach for an assessment • GHG data review and validation notes (plausibility checks, data gaps, proposed proxies or literature values) • GHG calculations and carbon-intensity assessments (including RSB GHG Calculator outputs) • GHG, LCA or sustainability assessment reports based on agreed templates • Feedstock eligibility and low-ILUC risk assessments • Regulatory and voluntary-scheme benchmarking and gap analyses • Certification-readiness reviews and evidence/documentation checks • Policy and regulatory interpretation notes and literature reviews with practical compliance options Methodologies, blueprints and decision tools for innovative sustainability assessments Benefits Working with RSB offers the opportunity to contribute to a globally recognised organisation at the forefront of sustainability and systems transformation. · Meaningful, mission-driven work: Contribute to advancing sustainability standards and real-world impact across global value chains, influencing how industries operate and evolve. · Flexible, high-impact assignments: Participate in intellectually engaging, project-based work that allows you to apply your expertise to real-world challenges. · Opportunity for ongoing collaboration: Consultants on the roster may be engaged on multiple assignments, fostering longer-term professional relationships with RSB. ______________________________________ Submission deadline: 24 October 2026 Type of Engagement: Project-based (as required) with an overarching Framework Agreement Preferred Provider Type: Independent consultants and individuals, firms, agencies, and established organisations. Working Hours / Time Zone: CET ±4 hours time-zone compatibility, unless otherwise agreed for a specific assignment (minimum 4 hours per day overlapping with CET working hours). title: Junior Talent Acquisition Partner (m/w/d)
description: Davon träumen wir: Mehr als Recruiting. Die richtigen Menschen für die richtigen Aufgaben. VielfaltMenü befindet sich in einer Phase der Weiterentwicklung. Wir schärfen unsere Organisation, professionalisieren unsere Prozesse und richten uns noch konsequenter auf unsere Kund:innen, unsere Mitarbeiter:innen und nachhaltiges Wachstum aus. Dazu gehört auch ein neues Verständnis von Recruiting. Wir wollen Stellen nicht einfach besetzen. Wir wollen verstehen, welche Kompetenzen wir wirklich benötigen, wie wir sie erkennen und welche Menschen zu unserer Organisation und unseren Zielen passen. Dafür suchen wir dich als Junior Talent Acquisition Partner:in Du musst nicht bereits zehn Jahre Recruiting-Erfahrung mitbringen. Entscheidend sind für uns analytisches Denken, Neugier, ein ausgeprägter Qualitätsanspruch und die Fähigkeit, Menschen und Kompetenzen gut einzuschätzen. Deine Aufgaben Du begleitest Recruitingprozesse von der ersten Anforderungsanalyse bis zum unterschriebenen Arbeitsvertrag und entwickelst gemeinsam mit People & Culture unsere Recruitingstandards weiter. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Führungskräften und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Talent Acquisition & Beratung Du führst strukturierte Briefings mit Führungskräften und übersetzt Anforderungen in klare Kompetenz- und Kandidatenprofile. Du berätst Führungskräfte bei der Auswahl geeigneter Kandidat:innen und sprichst auch dann eine klare Empfehlung aus, wenn die einfachste Lösung nicht die beste ist. Interviews führst du eigenständig – vom operativen Recruiting bis hin zu Gesprächen auf Managementebene. Kompetenzorientierte Auswahl Wir wollen Auswahlentscheidungen stärker auf Kompetenzen und nachvollziehbare Kriterien stützen. Du entwickelst strukturierte Interviewleitfäden, Bewertungsmatrizen und Auswahlstandards und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Entscheidungen vergleichbarer und belastbarer werden. Bei diagnostischen Auswahlverfahren und Assessments begleitest du Konzeption, Durchführung und Auswertung. Dein Anspruch dabei: weniger Bauchgefühl, mehr Qualität in der Entscheidung . Candidate Experience & Kreativität Professionelle Prozesse dürfen trotzdem persönlich sein. Du entwickelst Ideen, wie wir Kandidat:innen besser erreichen und ihnen vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Einstellung eine überzeugende Candidate Experience bieten. Dabei probierst du neue Recruitingwege aus, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns moderne Recruitingformate. Vertragsmanagement & Prozesse Du steuerst den Recruitingprozess zuverlässig bis zum Vertragsabschluss. Du bereitest Vertragsangebote vor, koordinierst Abstimmungen und sorgst dafür, dass Vereinbarungen vollständig, korrekt und termingerecht umgesetzt werden. Arbeitsrechtliche und datenschutzrechtliche Fragestellungen erkennst du und kannst sie gemeinsam mit People & Culture bzw. unserer juristischen Expertise einordnen. Du arbeitest strukturiert, standardisiert und detailgenau – ohne dabei unnötige Bürokratie aufzubauen. Was du mitbringst Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Wirtschaftspsychologie, Psychologie, Personalmanagement, Wirtschafts- oder Rechtswissenschaften, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Erste praktische Erfahrung im Recruiting, Talent Acquisition, HR oder in der Personalauswahl ist hilfreich – beispielsweise durch Werkstudententätigkeiten, Praktika oder deine erste berufliche Station. Auch wenn du am Anfang deiner Karriere stehst, freuen wir uns ausdrücklich auf deine Bewerbung. Wichtiger als die Anzahl deiner Berufsjahre ist für uns, wie du denkst und arbeitest. Du hast Interesse an eignungsdiagnostischen und kompetenzorientierten Auswahlverfahren. Du kannst Gespräche strukturieren, genau zuhören, kritisch nachfragen und deine Einschätzung anschließend nachvollziehbar begründen. Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und keine Scheu davor, mit Führungskräften und Geschäftsführung auf Augenhöhe zu diskutieren. Juristische Fragestellungen – insbesondere rund um Arbeitsverträge und Arbeitsrecht – schrecken dich nicht ab. Idealerweise bringst du bereits entsprechende Grundkenntnisse mit. Du arbeitest sehr sorgfältig und hast gleichzeitig Freude daran, Dinge neu zu denken. Was uns bei dir besonders wichtig ist Kreativität . Du akzeptierst nicht automatisch, dass Recruiting so funktionieren muss, wie es schon immer funktioniert hat. Struktur. Du glaubst an Standards, klare Prozesse und nachvollziehbare Entscheidungen. Detailorientierung. Ein falsches Datum im Arbeitsvertrag ist für dich keine Kleinigkeit. Urteilsvermögen. Du möchtest verstehen, welche Kompetenzen jemand wirklich mitbringt – und nicht nur, wie gut sich jemand präsentieren kann. Mut zur Empfehlung. Von dir erwarten wir nicht nur Organisation. Wir wollen deine Einschätzung hören. Neugier. Du möchtest verstehen, wie unser Geschäft funktioniert und was unsere Führungskräfte und Teams erfolgreich macht. Was dich bei VielfaltMenü erwartet VielfaltMenü steht für „Mehr als gutes Essen.“ Wir versorgen täglich Menschen in Bildungseinrichtungen und entwickeln uns als Unternehmen kontinuierlich weiter. People & Culture soll dabei nicht nur verwalten, sondern die Entwicklung des Unternehmens aktiv unterstützen. Du bekommst deshalb die Möglichkeit, unser Recruiting nicht nur auszuführen, sondern mitzugestalten . Du arbeitest eng mit Führungskräften, dem People & Culture-Team sowie der Geschäftsführung zusammen und erhältst früh Verantwortung für eigene Recruitingprozesse. Gleichzeitig geben wir dir Raum, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln. In deiner Rolle genießt du echten Gestaltungsspielraum : Du baust moderne Qualitäts- sowie Prozessstrukturen aktiv mit auf und prägst die Standards eines führenden Unternehmens für Kita- und Schulverpflegung in Deutschland. Dabei profitierst du von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer Geschäftsführung, die Qualität strategisch fördert. Neben einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag in einem zukunftssicheren Markt erwarten dich eine attraktive, transparente Vergütung sowie klare Entwicklungsperspektiven durch strukturierte Einarbeitung und individuelle Weiterbildungen. Wir unterstützen deine Work-Life-Balance durch 30 Urlaubstage , geregelte Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten. Zudem erhältst du moderne Arbeitsmittel inklusive Diensthandy. Eine gute ÖPNV-Anbindung und ein engagiertes, kollegiales Team runden unser Angebot ab. Klingt nach dir? Dann interessiert uns nicht nur dein Lebenslauf. Wir möchten wissen, wie du über Menschen, Kompetenzen und gute Personalauswahl denkst. Bewirb dich bei uns und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns, wie Recruiting bei VielfaltMenü künftig funktioniert. description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The Role

The Territory Account Executive (TAE) is a key growth role within Everpure (formerly Pure Storage) Germany's Go-To-Market organisation. This position focuses on driving growth across all accounts not currently managed by an Account Executive, including the full install base, dormant accounts, and new inbound opportunities. TAEs are responsible for expanding Pure’s footprint, reigniting customer relationships, and capturing new business through a combination of direct engagement and partner collaboration.

As a Territory Account Executive (TAE), you’ll play a pivotal role in bringing this vision to life - helping customers unlock the power of their data, modernise their infrastructure, and accelerate transformation. You’ll join our Commercial team in Germany, with the autonomy to own a dynamic territory, driving growth across a broad set of customers, from re-engaging dormant relationships to winning new logos.

At Pure, you’ll join a culture built on curiosity, innovation, and integrity. We celebrate diverse perspectives, challenge convention, and empower our people to think big, take bold action, and make a measurable impact. This is your opportunity to grow your career with one of the most innovative technology companies in the world and to do work that truly changes how businesses use data to compete and win.

What You'll Do

  • Drive Account Growth & Pipeline: Execute sales activities to generate revenue, manage a high-volume pipeline, and contribute to closing deals on a quarterly basis.
  • Execute Outreach & Prospecting: Perform consistent, high-activity prospecting to penetrate new accounts, reach decision-makers, and learn how to win new business effectively.
  • Support Partner Strategy: Collaborate closely with Channel Partners and Partner Managers to align on customer engagement and utilise partner resources to advance opportunities.
  • Reactivate Customer Relationships: Focus on re-engaging dormant or inactive customers by discovering new business use cases and identifying potential refresh and expansion opportunities.
  • Build Foundational Skills: Develop and deliver proposals and business cases that clearly demonstrate the value of Pure's solutions, supported by internal experts.
  • Maintain Sales Discipline: Diligently manage sales technology (Salesforce), deliver accurate forecasts, and maintain strong time management to thrive in a fast-paced, team environment.

What You Bring

  • Proven Sales Experience: Demonstrated success in direct, full-lifecycle B2B technology sales with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding sales metrics (KPIs).
  • Sales Drive & Motivation: A high degree of self-motivation, strong time management skills, demonstrates initiative and the drive to learn quickly and succeed across both transactional and early-stage strategic sales motions.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Demonstrated success working with both internal teams and channel partners to ensure seamless customer engagement and shared goal achievement.
  • Digital Proficiency: Proficiency with core sales technologies, including Salesforce and G Suite, and an ability to use data to prioritise daily activities.
  • Communication & Presence: Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for engaging with business leaders and maintaining professional business relationships.
  • Resilience & Focus: A competitive, positive attitude combined with strong organisational and time management skills necessary to handle a dynamic, high-activity territory.
  • Language Skills: Business Level, written and spoken, German and English language skills required.

Nice to Have

  • Industry Knowledge: Prior knowledge of the storage industry and familiarity with how data solutions drive business outcomes.
  • Channel Sales Expertise: Understanding of channel-led sales motions and experience collaborating effectively within the broader partner ecosystem.
  • Sales Training: Completion of a structured B2B sales methodology training (e.g., Business Value Selling or similar).
  • Digital Tools: Experience using digital prospecting and engagement tools (e.g., Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to accelerate the sales cycle.

About the role

At Agile Robots, we build powerful software frameworks to orchestrate complex robotic systems and solve challenging tasks. The solutions are sold to various international customers to enable them to control their robotic work cells. Smooth integration and scalable deployment are key goals.

AgileCore is meant to be a scalable platform that supports multiple projects in parallel. That only works if the platform underneath scales with it - if it stays fast, thread-safe, and diagnosable as projects, devices, and operating conditions multiply.

We are looking for a Senior C++ Performance Engineer to join our AgileCore Runtime core team. This is a T-shaped role in a small senior team: you are a full member of the core team first - contributing to the Runtime, reviewing contributions from the teams that build on our platform, and sharing our support and release duties - and within the team, you own the performance and stability practice as your specialization.

On the specialization side, you will drive the performance of the Runtime core - the Blackboard, the Behavior Engine and the execution paths beneath them - make the system provably thread-safe under load, and make failures in the field fast to diagnose. You own the practice: the methodology, the tooling, the benchmarks, the audits and the education. You work hand in hand with the platform architect, who owns the performance budgets and hot-path interface contracts at the architecture level - you turn those budgets into measured, enforced reality and shape them with your findings. You set the standard for performance, concurrency and troubleshooting, and raise the team's ability to meet it without slowing feature development down.   • Investigate complex issues across software, OS, network, and hardware boundaries - including the hardest escalations from the field
  • Partner with the platform architect on performance-critical design: propose and implement improvements within the platform's performance budgets and hot-path interface contracts, and feed measurements back into how those budgets are set

  • Strong experience with multi-threaded and concurrent programming: memory models, atomics, lock-free patterns, and the judgment to know when a plain mutex is the right answer
  • Exposure to real-time or near-real-time systems on Linux is strongly preferred: scheduling policies, preemption, priority inversion, CPU affinity, and the usual sources of jitter - deep prior RT experience is a plus, not a gate; the performance fundamentals matter more
  • Strong debugging skills using GDB, sanitizers (ASan/TSan/UBSan), Valgrind, perf, strace, ltrace, tcpdump, and core dumps

  • Experience with CMake and compiler toolchains (GCC, Clang)

title: Senior Workday Solution Architect - HR Technology (m/f/d)
description: At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. As Senior / Expert HR Tech Solution Architect , you will join the People & Organization Digital Transformation team to help shape and transform Flix's global HR technology landscape. Together with FlixTech, you will support the architecture, integration landscape and governance framework across a complex, multi-entity and multi-country organization — ensuring our technology enables Flix's future HR target operating model. The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams globally. You will help set the technical and architectural direction that the wider team — including our AI & Automation Engineers and HR Tech Business Analysts — builds within. This role is based in Berlin, given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required. About the Role Work closely with FlixTech, shape Flix's target HR technology architecture across core HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, talent, recruiting, document management and surrounding enterprise systems — ensuring the architecture enables our HR target operating and service-delivery model by connecting processes, roles, systems and service tiers while balancing global standards with local requirements. Drive global HRIS transformation initiatives, from major platform revamps and redesigns to potential HRIS migrations — evaluating technology options, building business cases, structuring programs through project plans and RAID/risk frameworks, and driving execution through solution design, integrations, testing, cutover, parallel runs and stabilization. Define HR technology integrations and data flows between the HRIS and surrounding enterprise systems — determining what data moves between systems and through which integration patterns, including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, SFTP, middleware and event-driven architectures. Establish and evolve HR technology governance and control frameworks, including system ownership and RACI, security and role-model design, least privilege and segregation of duties, audit trails, change/release governance, internal controls and data privacy aligned with GDPR and audit/IPO-readiness expectations. Act as the bridge between HR functional and technology teams, translating business and process requirements into target-state solutions and executable designs, and driving global HR technology implementation projects from requirements through go-live. About You 6+ years of experience in HR technology transformation, HRIS, solution architecture, enterprise architecture or HRIS delivery, with a degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Technology or a related field. Strong HR domain and Workday expertise, with an understanding of how core HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, talent, recruiting and surrounding enterprise systems work together across a global HR technology landscape. Any Workday certifications would be an advantage. Demonstrable experience driving Workday transformations, including major Workday redesigns, platform revamps and/or migrations end to end. Hands-on enterprise Workday experience across configuration, integration or migration is a strong differentiator. Strong integration and systems architecture knowledge, including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, SFTP, middleware, data flows and event-driven architectures across complex enterprise environments. Experience supporting the design of HR target operating models, HR service-delivery models and technology governance frameworks, including security and role models, segregation of duties, audit trails, internal controls and data privacy in regulated, multi-country environments. Experience with cloud architecture and AI & automation technologies is critical, including areas such as Claude/GenAI deployment, MCPs, n8n and Rovo Agents, alongside strong Jira project-management capabilities. Fluency in English. Certifications in solution/enterprise architecture, project management, agile or automation (e.g. TOGAF, PMP, SAFe, Scrum, Six Sigma, n8n) are a plus. We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! title: Software Engineer, Feature Engineering Platform
description: About Wolt At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe. Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. About the Role We're building a new Feature Engineering Platform that will be the front door to ML development at global scale. As a Software Engineer on this team, you'll help build a seamless experience for ML practitioners across the company — from experimentation and exploration to deployment and monitoring. Our mission is to make machine learning accessible and intuitive without compromising on power or performance. You'll work on a layered platform that supports both high-level declarative workflows and lower-level imperative APIs, all integrated into the environments our users already work in (like notebooks and internal sandboxes). What You'll Do Build and evolve APIs, SDKs, and platform integrations that power feature engineering workflows. Help shape user-facing tools to make the platform approachable for all skill levels. Collaborate across the ML lifecycle — from data ingestion to feature serving — and integrate tightly with our central Data Control Plane. Contribute to platform reliability, testing, observability, and operational excellence. Qualifications Solid engineering background, ideally in platform, data, or ML-adjacent teams. Comfortable working with backend systems, APIs, and ideally some exposure to distributed compute (e.g. Spark, Flink). Empathy for users and interest in building abstractions that remove friction. Curious and collaborative mindset — eager to learn from others and contribute broadly. Experience with ML tooling, or data pipelines is a plus. Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Empower every employee. Flip ist die führende KI-gestützte Employee Experience Platform für Frontline Worker. Wir revolutionieren, wie die Menschen arbeiten, die die Welt am Laufen halten- in Retail, Manufacturing und Logistics. Eine App. Ein Touch. Alles, was sie brauchen. Unsere Mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch. Stellenausschreibung KI-Orchestrierung steht im Zentrum der Zukunft von Flip. Flip Fusion, ein Multi-Agenten-System zur Code-Generierung, bildet das Herzstück unseres neuesten Produkts. Auch das Ask AI Agent Gateway und die Automatisierung durch Flip Flows laufen auf Fähigkeiten, die unsere KI-Engineers entwickeln und pflegen. Als Lead AI Engineer übernimmst du die KI-Disziplin: Du verantwortest das Wie, also Architektur, Standards und technische Ausrichtung, über alle drei Bereiche hinweg, führst und entwickelst ein Team von drei AI-Engineers weiter und bleibst dabei hands-on an den anspruchsvollsten Problemen. Was dich erwartet KI-Architektur verantworten : Definiere eine kohärente KI-Architektur und einheitliche Standards für Flip Fusion, das Ask AI Agent Gateway und Flip Flows, und stimme sie aufeinander ab. Die größte Herausforderung annehmen : Multi-Agenten-Systeme, die für konkrete Anwendungsfälle gebaut sind, aber generisch genug bleiben, um unterschiedliche Kund:innen zu bedienen, immer im Spannungsfeld zwischen hohen Ansprüchen, Machbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz. title: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
description:
Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)

The opportunity

Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly 3,000 people work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.

More than 500,000 healthcare professionals use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately 90 million people across Europe.

For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an AI-powered Health Companion that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.

This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.

We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.

What you will build and lead

As Product Design Director, Patient, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams.

Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:

  • access to care, search and booking;
  • patient messaging and teleconsultation;
  • the Patient Health Record and patient context;
  • the app homepage and daily health experience;
  • health content and prevention;
  • recommendations, reminders and care plans;
  • new patient services and subscription experiences;
  • conversational and AI-powered experiences.

The current team includes six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.

Your mandate

You will:

  • Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.
  • Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.
  • Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.
  • Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.
  • Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.
  • Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.
  • Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.
  • Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.
  • Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.
  • Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.

What success looks like

In your first year, you will have:

  • established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;
  • raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;
  • helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;
  • strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;
  • developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;
  • helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.

What we are looking for

You are likely to bring:

  • Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership..
  • Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people.
  • A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance.
  • Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers.
  • Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product.
  • Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour.
  • A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control.
  • Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant.
  • The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum.
  • A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction.
  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts.
  • Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus.
  • A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility.

Why Doctolib, why now?

Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters.

The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people’s everyday health journeys.

You will join at a defining moment:

  • Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support.
  • AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature.
  • The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped.
  • The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems.
  • The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built.

This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of consumer product design, healthcare and AI, and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future.

title: Sales Manager

Your number is your team's number, and your job is the thing that produces it: the quality of your people, the rigor of your deal strategy, and the discipline of your pipeline. Deal Strategy & Execution: Actively join critical customer conversations, challenge assumptions, eliminate risks, and design winning game plans alongside your AEs. You'll roll up your sleeves to support negotiations and business case development. Sales Excellence: Implement and coach on proven sales methodologies (MEDDIC) while creating a culture of continuous improvement through regular training in discovery, negotiation, and process management. Performance Optimization: Drive team performance through structured metrics tracking, pipeline reviews, and action planning. You'll identify improvement opportunities and implement solutions that increase win rates and deal velocity. Become AI Native: Proactively identify opportunities to leverage AI to accelerate the work of your team, experiment with new approaches, and share successful workflows – contributing to Tacto's culture of high-velocity execution and innovation. Customers stay, they grow, and our product team ships against a real vision, so every quarter your AEs walk into calls with something they could not say the quarter before. That means you will not spend your first year explaining why anyone should care. You will spend it coaching sellers who are ambitious, hungry to grow, and carry almost no ego about it, the kind who ask for feedback and then act on it. Whatever you have learned in your career lands on fertile soil here. Why Tacto A standout sales organization built for the long term ~90% of AEs hit their quota, with top performers reaching up to 400% Incentives that reward over-performance: 150% uncapped kicker No compromises on the talent bar: a lean, high-density team of A-players who push each other, with zero elbow culture. We hire the best, incentivize them right, and promote from within. Top-tier support so your team can focus on closing CVMs recruited exclusively from top-tier consultancies (BCG, Inverto, AT Kearney, Oliver Wyman) own onboarding and tee up your upsells, a Proof of Value team builds your business case in 48 hours, plus dedicated Value Engineers, Solution Engineers, Sales Ops, and a BDR machine that delivers the majority of your qualified pipeline A truly AI-native sales organization Access to all the leading AI tools plus a stack of custom agents that handle the work that used to eat your week, from meeting prep and demo follow-ups to value cases, call coaching, and instant battlecards, so you spend your time selling, not preparing to sell We invest to keep it that way: dedicated 'AI captains' across every team, with a group focused on Sales and Go-to-Market, building new tooling and running enablement so new knowledge spreads fast Backed to win big Sequoia- and Index-funded, with €50M+ behind us. Our founders sit at the same table as the people defining the global AI agenda, from Sam Altman to Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs. We're building Tacto to be the lighthouse for European industrial AI. A front-row seat in the European startup ecosystem Weekly exposure to leading founders and operators through internal and external events e.g. Sales-focused Events with CRO of DeepL , CRO of Dash0 or ex Head of RevOps at Forto Our Background Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material. Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans. Why It Matters Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives. But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI. Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech. title: Customer Success Engineer
description: As a Customer Success Engineer at vCluster, you aren't just managing accounts — you are the primary architect of customer outcomes after the deal closes. You are not a reactive support resource. You are a proactive partner who drives adoption, identifies expansion opportunities, and spots churn before it becomes visible. You build deep relationships with Platform Engineering leaders, DevOps teams, and executive buyers alike — and you can talk credibly with all of them. Your Role and Impact: Onboarding Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer onboardings — from the sales handoff through to project close. You coordinate architecture workshops, platform installation, access setup, integration configuration, and operational readiness reviews. You set the tone for how customers experience vCluster from day one. Success Planning: Build and maintain customer success plans that document business objectives, KPIs, adoption milestones, and a forward plan. You treat the success plan as a living document that drives every customer conversation, not a one-time deliverable that sits in a folder. Value Articulation: Translate platform adoption into business outcomes. You connect Tenant Cluster growth, provisioning time savings, and developer self-service enablement to the metrics your customers care about — cost efficiency, engineering velocity, risk reduction, and platform ROI. When it's time to renew or expand, the business case is already built. Proactive Engagement: Own the customer relationship cadence — regular check-ins, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Executive Business Reviews. You do not wait for the customer and you run executive reviews that reinforce strategic partnership, not just feature updates. Technical Credibility: Hold credible technical conversations with platform engineers, DevOps leads, and architects. You understand the vCluster architecture well enough to discuss Tenant Cluster deployment patterns, RBAC, Tenant Isolation, integrations, and Day 2 operations. You can independently assist the customer with their technical challenges and design optimal deployment architectures. Renewal and Expansion: Own the renewal motion for your accounts — starting 90+ days out. You recognise expansion triggers — new use cases, AI/GPU workloads, additional Tenant Clusters, tier upgrades — and you work with the Account Executive and Solutions Engineer to convert them into growth that solves real customer problems. Customer Advocacy: Serve as the internal voice of your customers. You represent their feature requests, escalate blockers, and provide actionable feedback to Product and Engineering grounded in real account context — not anecdote. This Role is a Fit for You If: Proven Post-Sales Experience: You have experience in a technical post-sales role — customer success, technical account management, or professional services — with a track record of driving adoption and measurable business outcomes across a portfolio of technical customers. Technical Credibility: You have hands-on familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies. You can engage with platform engineers on architecture questions, discuss RBAC and Tenant Isolation patterns, and hold your ground in a conversation about cloud infrastructure without bluffing. You know when to bring in deeper technical resources. Stakeholder Range: You can run an executive business review with a Head of Technology in the morning and troubleshoot an onboarding question with a platform engineer in the afternoon. You adapt your communication without losing depth or credibility in either direction. Structured and Proactive: You operate with a clear framework — success plans, adoption milestones, renewal timelines — and you don't need to be reminded to use them. You identify risk before the customer tells you about it. Commercial Awareness: You understand what drives renewal and expansion in a SaaS or platform business. You surface growth opportunities that solve real customer problems, not just opportunities that look good on a pipeline report. Bonus Points For: Kubernetes certification (CKA or CKAD) or equivalent demonstrated technical depth in cloud-native infrastructure. Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, GPU compute environments, or customers building internal developer platforms at scale. Background working with regulated industries — financial services, healthcare, or public sector -- where compliance and governance add complexity to technical decisions. Contributions to the Kubernetes or open-source ecosystem. Experience at a Series B-D startup where you've operated with autonomy and helped build a repeatable post-sales motion from the ground up. About vCluster Labs We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture. We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software. We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems. Benefits We offer the following benefits: Competitive Salary : We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity. Premium Insurance : Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country). Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day. Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way. Culture & Values At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for: Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow.
